session.description: Polar LEO shell phased for close seam crossings. Six counter-rotating pairs between plane 5 and plane 0 pass within 230 km at 67 degrees latitude, where the required tracking rate exceeds the terminal's 2 degree per second limit for about 30 s while line of sight and range still permit the link. A tracking-limit experiment; each pair also gains and loses by range once per hemisphere.
session.name: earth-leo-polar-seam-tracking

link_rules:
- id: leo_access
  topology:
    mode: visible_candidates
  endpoints:
  - select:
      all:
      - segment: ground
      - tag: leo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: access
      - medium: rf
    # Gateway feeder mask: Iridium-class gateways track to low elevation
    # (~8-10 deg). At 25 deg this 36-sat shell connects some inter-site
    # pair only ~52% of the time (simulated); at 10 deg, ~87%.
    min_elevation_deg: 10
  - select:
      segment: leo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: access
      - medium: rf
- id: leo_isl
  topology:
    mode: explicit_pairs
    pairs:
    # The counter-rotating seam pairs with a two-slot offset: the close pass.
    - {a: sat-p05s00, b: sat-p00s02}
    - {a: sat-p05s01, b: sat-p00s03}
    - {a: sat-p05s02, b: sat-p00s04}
    - {a: sat-p05s03, b: sat-p00s05}
    - {a: sat-p05s04, b: sat-p00s00}
    - {a: sat-p05s05, b: sat-p00s01}
  endpoints:
  - select:
      segment: leo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: isl
      - medium: optical
  - select:
      segment: leo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: isl
      - medium: optical
simulation:
  candidate_limits:

    max_pairs_per_tick: 2000
time:
